decisive_items: numerous dermal ectatic blood vessels and lymphatics with a sparse lymphocytic infiltrate
response.rationale: Biopsy finding of ectatic lymphatics is specific for lymphangioma, whereas edema lacks such histologic confirmation.

rejected.why: Clinical edema only, no biopsy support and no response to antihistamines/corticosteroids.
Non-pitting edema is nonspecific; biopsy contradicting lymphatic malformation not typical.
No sicca symptoms or autoimmune features; negative tuberculin and patch tests.
Same as R6; overlapping and unsupported.
Biopsy lacks fibrosis or collagen changes characteristic of scleroderma.
